citation.title: Tailoring tokamak error fields to control plasma instabilities and transport
citation.authors: Yang, S.; Park, J.-K.; Jeon, Y.; Logan, N. C.; et al.

topic: n=1 error-field correction with 3D coils on KSTAR to suppress ELMs and avoid core locked modes; edge-localized RMP; avoiding H-mode transition to sustain high core Ti.
own_question: Can 3D coil currents be optimized to keep edge resonant fields while minimizing core resonance?
actual_method_and_evidence: The paper uses IPEC ideal-MHD coupling matrices with SVD and a core-null projection to design coil spectra. It reports KSTAR discharge comparisons (for example 26025–26027, 31357/31359) using Dα, Thomson, and CES rotation and Ti profiles, ECEI coherence, and BES bicoherence. The ion-temperature data come from CES; the extracted text does not specify the impurity species or chord. All analysis is offline. There is no nowcasting, estimator, or validation design.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: KSTAR studies use CES-measured ion temperature and rotation profiles, alongside BES and ECEI fluctuation diagnostics, to characterize pedestal and core changes under 3D fields.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p4 (CES in Fig.4 text); p5–6 (ECEI, BES bicoherence; Fig.6 Ti)
claim_checks.qualification: This is offline profile analysis of different discharges. It is not a real-time measurement and not related to report latency. The text does not state whether CES reflects impurity or main-ion Ti.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not relevant. CES report timing and latency are not discussed.
validation_if_relevant: None. The evidence is a small set of discharge comparisons. No held-out data or statistical validation is reported.
forbidden_inferences: Do not claim the paper shows BES or ECEI predict CES Ti.
Do not claim CES latency motivated this work.
Do not claim the KSTAR2022 campaign or our chord was used.
Do not treat the 100 million kelvin Ti as a validated label or the study's target.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: At most, this is an optional application-context citation: the 3D-field control literature uses CES Ti and BES/ECEI on KSTAR. It offers no support for nowcasting methods or timing claims. It can be omitted unless the applications paragraph needs a KSTAR control example.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
